$comment: Contract of the Auth blocks (escala-governance step 2). Anatomy and variants mirror the Figma set; nests lists every escala-ui component the block draws; motion lists each moving part with its role. A block draws no colour, length or type of its own.

blocks.name: AuthAccountLocked
anatomy: header-area (ModalHeader, Align vertical-center in card · horizontal in plain)

layout inline: ModalHeader Align horizontal Size lg; Field, Button, SocialLoginButton, InputOTP, SegmentedControl lg; CheckboxItem, Checkbox, PasswordStrength, Alert default; footer body-md + TextLink sm
a11y: The block is a <section>; the header's title is its heading
Every field is a Field (label, description, error tied to the control)
An inline notice is aria-live=polite
Icon-only social buttons carry the full label as aria-label

motion.moment: content swap (the block mounts or its key changes)
motion.mechanism: inline transition on the body region
motion.reduced: fade kept, travel neutralised by the token

blocks.name: AuthSignInPasskey
anatomy: header-area (ModalHeader, Size lg, Align vertical-left, icon hidden)
body (Field email, Button Continue, Separator OR, Button passkey, three SocialLoginButtons)
a11y: The block is a <section> named by its title
Every field is a Field (label, description, error tied to the control)
Inside a Modal the title is the dialog's accessible name

blocks.name: AuthSignInPhone
anatomy: header-area (ModalHeader, Align vertical-center in card · horizontal in plain; FeaturedIcon secondary, a phone)
actions (gap-group): Button · Separator (OR) · Button (secondary, mail icon)
country picker: an anchored Popover on every viewport (search Input + ComboboxItem rows)

layout inline: ModalHeader Align horizontal Size lg; Field, Button, SocialLoginButton, InputOTP, SegmentedControl lg; CheckboxItem, Checkbox, PasswordStrength, Alert default; footer body-md + TextLink sm
a11y: The block is a <section>; the header's title is its heading
The phone field is a Field (label, error tied to the control by aria-describedby; aria-invalid); input type=tel, inputmode=tel, autocomplete=tel
The country trigger is a combobox: aria-expanded, aria-controls, ArrowDown opens, typing opens with the query

In the picker the search is the combobox: aria-activedescendant, ArrowUp / Down / PageUp / PageDown / Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End move the highlight, Enter picks, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger
The list is a listbox of options with aria-setsize / aria-posinset (it draws only the rows in view)
The search is not focused on a touch device (no keyboard before the list is visible)

motion.moment: content swap (the block mounts or its key changes)
motion.mechanism: inline transition on the body region
motion.reduced: fade kept, travel neutralised by the token

motion.mechanism: the Field's own disclosure: grid-rows + opacity + margin on the disclosure roles (recipe motion Field.errorRegion); the block adds nothing
the Popover choreography on the panel (data-state), from the trigger
